note: The adapters known to read their source correctly, as of 2026-08-30.
This is deliberately the SHORT list rather than the long one. Reporting every
adapter that cannot anchor, every month, would be an alert nobody reads by the
third time -- the failure the shell-size gate was written to escape: a warning
that always fires is not a warning. So the check fails only when an adapter ON
THIS LIST stops working.
Holding the healthy set rather than the broken one is also more stable: the
split between 'could not parse' and 'unreachable' moves run to run as sites
flake, and a shard being watched or not does not.
This list should GROW. Every id added is a shard that is genuinely being
watched again. Adding one means dry-running the adapter and reading the diff
(`node scripts/refresh/run.ts --adapter <id> --dry-run`) -- anchoring proves
the parser found something shaped like its figure, never that the value is
right, and on 2026-08-29 nine adapters anchored the wrong number.
It went from five to thirty-two on 2026-08-29, each addition dry-run to a no-op
against its committed figures. Mississippi joined on 2026-08-30 and is the
thirty-third: every *.ms.gov host serves an incomplete certificate chain, so the
state was not unwatched but unreachable, and the shared fetch now repairs the
chain the way a browser does. Its rate steps down by statute every January.
cpi-u-annual joined on 2026-08-30. It had been reported unreachable because BLS's
keyless API spends its daily quota against a shared runner IP; the quota resets, and
since an unreachable adapter no longer counts as a regression even when it is on this
list, a source that answers most days can now be watched without a monthly false alarm.
gift-tax-2024 joined on 2026-08-30 and is the first adapter written for a shard
that had none. It reads the same revenue procedure the federal bracket adapter
already fetched every month -- the document its citation had named since it was
written. Four more shards cite that same PDF and still have no adapter; see
scripts/refresh/watch-coverage.json.
All five shards that cited rp-25-32.pdf now read it: gift-tax, amt, child-tax
(the dependent standard deduction), capital-gains and eitc-ctc, added 2026-08-30
and each dry-run to a no-op. The document was already being fetched every month
for the federal brackets.
retirement-limits and ira-deduction joined on 2026-08-30, reading Notice 2025-67.
With those, no shard on watch-coverage.json is flagged THE REAL GAP any more:
every remaining entry there is a decision rather than unwritten work.
